realm.name: viewer
realm.description: Read the box: browse files, search their contents, download bytes, read the config a service declares, and read cluster events and logs. Gates 5 routers (bothy-files read + download, bothy-config read, bothy-ops kube events + logs).

realm.name: editor
realm.description: Change a file on disk, and patch a declared config field. Saves write straight to the working tree. Gates 3 routers (bothy-files write + delete, bothy-config patch - all served by bothy-files).

realm.name: operator
realm.description: Act on what is running - restart, stop and start a service; restart, scale or clean up a cluster workload. Gates 6 routers, one per verb or action (bothy-ops). There is no exec and no kill.

realm.name: shell
realm.description: HIGH PRIVILEGE: arbitrary terminal. Keep composite=false and never nest it in another role. Step-up re-auth: see auth/compose.yml.

clients.name: oauth2-proxy (Traefik forwardAuth)
clients.description: The shared forwardAuth client. Traefik asks oauth2-proxy for a verdict; it asks Keycloak. Secret and redirect URI are injected from .env at import.

clients.name: Headlamp (read-only cluster browser)
clients.description: oauth2-proxy-headlamp in front of Headlamp on its own port. Imported DISABLED and with no secret; scripts/keycloak-headlamp-client.sh sets the secret from .env and enables it.
